---
name: "SDLC Step 08 Pull Request Instructions"
description: "Use when preparing or creating the final GitHub pull request from verified SDLC changes, reviewing verification evidence, or completing SDLC Phase 8."
---
# SDLC Step 08: Pull Request

- Read the verification report and inspect the final change set before preparing the PR.
- Confirm that the verification evidence is real, reproducible, and clearly tied to acceptance criteria.
- Use a concise title that states the user-visible feature or outcome.
- Include summary, implementation notes, test commands and results, known limitations, and relevant artifacts in the PR body.
- Do not claim unrun tests or resolved issues; preserve blockers and residual risks honestly.
- Keep the PR focused on the approved feature and avoid unrelated cleanup.
- Use the configured repository and target branch from the orchestrator; do not invent repository metadata.
- Report the created PR URL, or state exactly why creation was blocked.
